verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents running multiple agents in parallel on the same project and has desktop tabs. A community user reports that its WebUI can connect to several OpenCode backends at once, which points toward a single place to manage multiple sessions. However, the docs never describe a dedicated unified session-management workspace, and a hands-on user reports bugs restoring session state and agents getting stuck in long or nested sessions. missing for 10: first-party documentation of a unified workspace or dashboard for monitoring and switching between parallel sessions, documented cross-project session management, independent corroboration of reliable multi-session operation.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can manage multiple agent-driven coding sessions from one unified workspace
